data.name: Murtad
data.gender_notes: Murtad is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who turns away from faith or obedience to Allah. The name Murtad carries the meaning “Apostate, Rebel” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Murtad usually hope their child will grow to embody apostate, rebel and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those who have turned away from their spiritual path and are seeking to return
data.etymology: Murtad belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Apostate, Rebel.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Murtad total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: مرتد
in_arabic.meaning: منافق أو كافر أو راجع عن الإسلام
in_arabic.long_meaning: مرتد هو الشخص الذي يترك الإسلام أو يرتد عن دينه، و يعتبر في الإسلام كمن يترك الدين الحق. وردت هذه الكلمة في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قول الله تعالى: 'وَمَنْ يَرْتَدِدْ مِنْكُمْ عَنْ دِينِهِ فَيَمُتْ وَهُوَ كَافِرٌ فَأُولَئِكَ حَبِطَتْ أَعْمَالُهُمْ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ وَأُولَئِكَ أَصْحَابُ النَّارِ هُمْ فِيهَا خَالِدُونَ' (البقرة: 217). تعتبر كلمة مرتد ذات أهمية كبيرة في الشريعة الإسلامية، حيث تشير إلى الخروج عن الدين الإسلامي.

in_urdu.name: مرتد
in_urdu.meaning: منافق یا کافر یا اسلام سے برگشتہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: مرتد وہ شخص ہوتا ہے جو اسلام چھوڑ دیتا ہے یا اپنے دین سے رجوع کرتا ہے۔ اسلامی شریعت میں مرتد کو ایک سنگین جرم سمجھا جاتا ہے، اور اس کے لئے سخت سزا مقرر کی گئی ہے۔ مرتد کے موضوع پر اسلامی علماء اور فقهاء نے وسیع بحث کی ہے، اور اس کے مختلف پہلوؤں کا تجزیہ کیا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: मुर्तद
in_hindi.meaning: मुनाफिक या काफिर या इस्लाम से वापस
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुर्तद वह व्यक्ति होता है जो इस्लाम छोड़ देता है या अपने धर्म से वापस चला जाता है। इस्लामी परंपरा में मुर्तद को एक गंभीर अपराध माना जाता है, और इसके लिए कठोर सजा निर्धारित की गई है। मुर्तद के विषय पर इस्लामी विद्वानों और फकीहों ने व्यापक चर्चा की है, और इसके विभिन्न पहलुओं का विश्लेषण किया है।

in_pashto.name: مرتد
in_pashto.meaning: منافق یا کافر یا له اسلامه راپسې
in_pashto.long_meaning: مرتد هغه څوک دی چې اسلام پرېږدي او يا له دينه واپس شي. په اسلامي شريعت کې مرتد يو سخت جرم ګڼل کيږي، او د هغې لپاره سخت سزا ټاکل شوې ده. په افغانستان کې مرتد په ډېر احتیاط سره ګډل کيږي، او د هغې شرعي او فقهي اړخونه په پام کې نيول کيږي.

in_english.name: Murtad
in_english.meaning: One who reverts or apostatizes from Islam
in_english.long_meaning: Murtad refers to an individual who renounces or reverts from Islam, considered a serious offense in Islamic law. Etymologically derived from the Arabic root 'ر-ت-د' (r-t-d), which conveys the meaning of 'to return' or 'to turn back,' the term has significant implications in Islamic theology and jurisprudence. Historically, apostasy has been addressed in the Quran and Hadith, with specific references in Surah Al-Baqarah (2:217) and Surah An-Nisa (4:137). The concept of murtad has been extensively discussed by Islamic scholars, exploring its implications on faith, community, and individual rights.

pronunciation.urdu: مرتد کا تلفظ ہے م ر ت د
pronunciation.pashto: د مرتد تلفظ دى م ر ت د

data.cultural_impact: In Islamic culture, the term "Murtad" holds grave significance as it refers to an individual who has willfully and intentionally abandoned the Muslim faith. The fatal consequences of this act come in the form of social ostracism, legal ramifications, and emotionally charged reactions from the community. In certain Muslim-majority societies, the term remains a taboo, and the person ceases to be considered a part of the Muslim community.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, being labeled a "Murtad" is a Source of deep sadness and regret. It's an utter disregard for the divine guidance and a violation of the sacred covenant between the individual and Allah. As a result, according to Islamic teachings, it would be challenging for the person to attain spiritual peace and growth as they have turned their backs on the divine truth.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Apostate, Rebel" symbolizes One who turns away from faith or obedience to Allah.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Murtad serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of apostate, rebel.
